verdict: Yes, for an engineering team that understands farming. Xmachines from Hyderabad pitched robotics and AI for agriculture on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Labour shortages are pushing farms toward automation, but robots must be affordable for Indian farmers.
angle: Robots for weeding, spraying and harvesting reduce labour needs. Renting robots or selling services per acre makes them affordable. FPOs and large farms are early buyers.
